title: Soul Feast #50: What’s Real? Meaning
excerpt: Your journey to Authentic Power begins here.
bodyHtml:
Your journey to Authentic Power begins here. Download your copy of the Authentic Power Guidelines today!

A profound shift in human consciousness is underway. In this Soul Feast, Gary invites listeners to explore what it truly means to live a life of meaning. While the five-sensory world measures worth in achievements, possessions, and external validation, Gary shows us that meaning comes from a deeper source – the soul.

Through stories, teachings, and timeless wisdom, 

Gary illustrates the difference between living from fear and illusion versus aligning with love and authentic power. 

Meaning is not found in intellect, appearances, or artificial intelligence. Instead, we experience true meaning when we recognize and use the unique gifts we were born to give.

At its heart, this conversation is an invitation to remember that authentic power and true fulfillment come only when we align our personality with our soul. Meaning isn’t something we chase – it’s something we live by choosing love over fear in every moment.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:00) — A New Consciousness Emerging: Why humanity is moving from a five-sensory to a multisensory way of experiencing reality.
  • (03:07) — Beyond Intellect: Why real meaning cannot be found in data, analysis, or AI, but in the deeper knowing of the soul.
  • (06:00) — Shadows and the Cave: How ancient wisdom illustrates the shift from illusion to authentic perception of reality.
  • (08:44) — Choice and Responsibility: Why Earth School always brings us back to the same decision—love or fear.
  • (11:56) — Illusion of Fear vs. Reality of Love: How fear distorts perception and why meaning only arises when we choose love.
  • (18:05) — No Separation: The realization that there are no “others,” only oneness, and why authentic power is inseparable from love.
  • (21:01) — A Life of Meaning: How aligning with the soul brings harmony, cooperation, and reverence for life.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

This week, take out your Soul Notebook. Write down the words, phrases, or moments from this episode that felt deeply meaningful to you – not intellectually, but as a deeper knowing. Notice how these insights resonate with your life. Ask yourself: Am I choosing fear or love in the way I live today? Return to your notes at the end of the week and reflect on how these choices shape your sense of meaning.
